title: Uruguayan Empanada Keto Delight
description: A crispy keto twist on traditional Uruguayan empanadas. Savory and rich, these empanadas are perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan ground beef
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cook to a safe internal temperature of 160°F (71°C)

ingredients.name: Crispy empanada wrappers
ingredients.notes: Look for low-carb options or make your own keto wrappers

ingredients.name: Aromatic onion
ingredients.notes: Chop finely and sauté until caramelized

ingredients.name: Fat (such as lard or coconut oil)
Score cheese (such as cheddar or mozzarella)
ingredients.notes: Add extra flavor to your empanada filling

instructions: In a large pan, cook the Uruguayan ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped aromatic onion to the pan and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded score cheese until melted and well combined with the beef mixture.
Brush the crispy empanada wrappers with fat (such as lard or coconut oil) on both sides.
Place a tablespoon or two of the beef and cheese mixture onto one half of each empanada wrapper.
Fold the wrappers in half to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving space between each empanada for even cooking.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with additional fat for a crispy finish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the empanadas are golden brown and crispy.
